notes: Backends: cpu = math_delta.c (single-threaded), cuda = math_delta_gpu.cu (device runs only), reconstruction = the FND-004 scope and bank of the updated rows (math_bank.c), duckdb = GROUP BY with SUM(weight * term) in HUGEINT over the updated bag (DuckDB's own threads).

An update costs the delta's rows times the terms plus one copy of the state's cells (groups x terms: the new state is an independent immutable object); it does not depend on the rows of the state. A reconstruction rescans every row. The initial build is timed apart from each update.
Group moves are a delete and an insert of the moved rows: a batch of k moves is 2k delta rows; the move frequency changes the touched groups, not the work per row.

Bilinear joins (one versus both changing sides of a join) belong to DELTA-002 (a later wave): DELTA-001 maintains linear (single-table) states, so the join cases of the inventory's second benchmark case are not measured here; the group-move frequency and the comparison of every update with complete reconstruction, refusals and rebuilds included, are.
